title: Governed Shopify net stamp (klints_net_ltv)
operator_disclosure: Prefer LE-09 PASS before stamping. Sets klints_net_ltv as a Manago dictionary detail type NUMBER storing integer cents (Shopify net dollars × 100) for orders in the import snapshot (not guaranteed lifetime). Predefine klints_net_ltv as NUMBER under Manago Settings → Dictionary Details before Approve. VIP/automation thresholds must use cents (e.g. klints_net_ltv >= 20000 means $200.00) — Manago compares the stored integer directly. Rejects incomplete refund history, mixed currency, out-of-definition, or zero net (Manago NUMBER must be a positive integer). Clears legacy properties text stamp when writing. After Approve, re-run DCS — PT-04 PASSes when stamped net matches Shopify net (repeat Approve if batch truncated).
